concerns.text: T002 requires `code/scoring/sart.py` to implement 'RT filter 100–5000 ms, accuracy check < 50% → low_attention', but no task produces trial-level RT/accuracy data: T003 writes `simulated_measurements.csv` conforming to `dataset.schema.yaml`, whose MeasurementRecord has only a single `value` per metric. The SART scoring functions have no input to operate on, so T002's unit tests can only test the functions in isolation while the end-to-end pipeline (T003 smoke slice, T005 low-attention flagging) cannot exercise them. Either add a task/artifact producing trial-level SART/Ospan raw responses (also required by Constitution VI 'raw response data MUST be preserved'), or re-scope T002 to score from the single-value records the schema actually supports.

T003 instructs 'read seed and parameters from `code/config/study_config.yaml`' and T001's runnable command references the same file, but no task is assigned to create `study_config.yaml` or specify its required keys (N, seed, dropout rate, effect parameters). An implementer cannot deterministically execute T003 without knowing the config schema. Assign config-file creation (with key list) to T001 or T003.

T006 says 'Holm-Bonferroni correction across the four outcome families' but the pipeline carries five metrics (SART, Ospan, PSS-10, PANAS-PA, PANAS-NA) per dataset.schema.yaml, and FR-008 says 'four outcome variables'. The implementer cannot determine the correction family count (4 vs 5) deterministically. State explicitly whether PANAS-PA/NA form one family or two.

T008(c) practice-effects sensitivity says 'e.g., 0, 0.2, 0.4 SD practice effect' — the 'e.g.' leaves the grid to implementer discretion, making the verification ('pytest passes; report discusses practice sensitivity') under-specified. Pin the exact practice-effect values and the metrics they apply to.
